text:
Four power banks in the search results support Qi2.2 25W wireless charging. Only two have US buy links in these results.

**Available to buy in the US**

- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10,000 mAh):** Qi2.2-certified, with up to 25W wireless and a 45W USB-C port. It's $79.99 on Amazon US and $59.99 on Baseus's site at launch ([Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Baseus-launches-new-Qi2-2-25W-certified-10-000-mAh-power-bank-with-slim-design.1223437.0.html)). Dealectric lists code **AM52** as taking $6 off, to $53.99, last tested in Baseus's cart on 2026-10-25. [Buy it here](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w). This is an affiliate link: Dealectric earns a commission, and it costs you nothing extra. The store's checkout has the final word on the price.
- **Anker MagGo 2 Pro (10,000 mAh):** Qi2.2 25W with an active cooling fan, 45W USB-C in and out, and a built-in display and stand. It's $109.99, but it's a pre-order shipping Oct 21 to Nov 9, 2026. It only works with Apple devices: iPhone 13 through 17, except the 16e. [Buy it on Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a110r-qi2-maggo-2-pro-magnetic-power-bank?Sort_by=Recommended&collections_anker-earth-day-sale-2026=&variant=46550444277910).

**Supports Qi2.2 25W, but I couldn't confirm current US pricing or a buy page**

- **UGREEN MagFlow 25W:** the first power bank certified for Qi2.2 by the Wireless Power Consortium. UGREEN said it would launch in Q3 2025 on Amazon and its own site ([UGREEN press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ugreen-pioneers-next-gen-wireless-charging-with-magflow-25w-the-worlds-first-qi-2-2-certified-power-bank-302505385.html)). The results give no price or product link, so check UGREEN's site or Amazon.
- **ESR MagSlim (10,000 mAh):** 13.8 mm thick, which ESR calls the thinnest Qi2 25W power bank. It was previewed at CES 2026 and is optimized for the iPhone 17 series ([ESR press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/esr-expands-its-qi2-25w-wireless-charging-lineup-advancing-everyday-charging-at-ces-2026-302653572.html)). The release says it's on Amazon and ESR's site but gives no price or direct link. ESR describes it as "Qi2 25W" rather than explicitly "Qi2.2".

CIO's SMARTCOBY Ex05 also supports Qi2.2 25W, but its release covers Japan only ([PR TIMES](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000665.000043212.html)), so I left it out.

**Which to pick:** The Baseus is the cheapest and ships now. The Anker costs more but adds active cooling, which should help sustain 25W. If you're on a Pixel 10 Pro XL or another Qi2.2 phone, Baseus lists support for those, while Anker lists only iPhones.
